lines.text:
I’m getting a present for my girlfriend...
Hmm...\c
I could give her a Water Stone, but who knows?
It might cause her to evolve!
There are Pokémon that evolve when you use an\nEvolution stone on them!
It looks like your [VAR POKNAME(0002)] wants to stick\nwith you just the way it is.
They don’t sell them here, but I’ve heard there\nare these amazing stones called Mega Stones\r\nout there somewhere.

“4F: Wiseman Gifts
“‘Express yourself with gifts!\c
“‘Evolution Special!
“‘Evolution stones on sale now!’”
